final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is analytically fair in one respect: aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and a 6% reversible rollout support operational launch readiness. But the governing compliance predicate is separate. The admissible evidence still shows an exposed named use case with a material limitation, no approved risk acceptance covering that exposure, and no evidence of required disclosure before launch. Under the stated policy, rollback, monitoring, and small initial percentage do not cure that gap while the affected segment remains exposed. Because the unresolved issue is an unmet compliance condition rather than a caveat on an otherwise satisfied condition, the appropriate final verdict remains noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: The aviation maintenance triage segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
That segment is below target on deferred-defect routing, leaving a live material limitation for a named launch use case.
There is no admissible evidence of a final disclosure covering the aviation maintenance triage limitation before launch.
The risk acceptance draft is not approved on this record because the approver line is blank.
The draft risk acceptance does not address the aviation maintenance triage exposure.
Policy states rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed unless the use case is excluded or reviewed risk acceptance exists.
